incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD alert triggered: Inference Gateway 5xx error rate spike in us-west2
```
Alert: inference.gateway.5xx_rate > 8% (5m)

Current: 12.3% (5m)
Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD123456
Runbook: /runbook/gateway-5xx
```

alex (oncall): acked. I'm on it, looking at ingress and routing.

jen-sre: I see a concurrent small uptick in kv-cache misses from the same AZ (~us-west2b) — could be hot prefix eviction. Pulling cache metrics now.

tony-ops: autoscaler shows 30% additional queue depth and no recent deploys in the past hour. No config changes on LB.

luis-support: raising escalation: Support dashboard shows ~40 unique customers with failed requests in the last 10m, errors are user-visible (500). Customer-impacting. Tagging @elaine-pm for customer comms.

elaine-pm: noted, prepping a short banner + status page note if we confirm >=100 failed requests across accounts. Keep me posted.

alex (oncall): quick triage steps: 1) check canary traffic weights 2) check kv cache eviction logs 3) verify fallback routing to eu region 4) temporarily increase pool in us-west2. Doing 1 & 2.

jen-sre: canary weights look normal. No ongoing rollout. Cache eviction spikes align with high long-tail prefix churn. Suggest warming hot prefixes and enabling read-through temporarily.

alex (oncall): command: ``/runbook gateway-5xx warm-kv-prefixes`` -> kicked off. Also bumping target pool by +20% for inference workers in us-west2.

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert escalated: PD123456 -> acknowledged by alex (oncall) at 2026-03-17T02:13:10Z. Next escalation in 10m if unack.

tony-ops: scaling action applied. Request queue dropped ~15% in the last 30s. Monitoring.

luis-support: customer reports reducing but still seeing failures. Current customer-facing count 22 (interactive). I'll open a ticket per affected account.

jen-sre: found a spike in a particular routing shard — backend proxy returning 502 due to a downstream HTTP client timeout to model-hosts. Increasing model-host connection pool and retry jitter. Patch applied to sidecar config on affected hosts.

alex (oncall): applying temporary routing policy: divert 20% of traffic from us-west2 -> us-east1 for customer-facing routes using `routing_policy: soft-fallback`. Rolling for 2m.

incident-bot: Automated action: routing policy change deployed. Telemetry stream: error-rate dropping from 12% -> 6% in 2m.

elaine-pm: thumbs up. Prepare a short customer note: "We observed an elevated error rate in us-west2; mitigations in progress; limited impact for a subset of customers." Will wait for final confirmation.

tony-ops: after routing and cache warm, current 5xx rate is 2.1% (5m). Latency p50 unchanged. Looks stable but still watching for recurrence.

luis-support: collecting list of affected customers, sending initial outreach to top-10. No major outages reported externally.

aj-night: I'm taking the handoff for overnight watch. Summary: spike in us-west2 caused by kv-cache eviction + downstream model-host client timeouts. Temporary mitigations: cache warm, increased pool, diverted traffic -> us-east1, scaled workers +20%. Current 5xx 2.1% and trending down. PD incident PD123456 remains open.

aj-night: leaving checklist: 1) keep autoscaler at +20% for 15m, 2) monitor kvcache miss rate, 3) rollback soft-fallback if recovery sustained, 4) coordinate RCA with SRE tomorrow.

alex (oncall): thanks @aj-night — handing off. If it flaps reopen PD and ping the oncall chain.

incident-bot: PD incident PD123456 -> reassigned to aj-night at 2026-03-17T02:16:29Z. Next escalation in 6h.

elaine-pm: filing customer comms draft and will circle back with PR for the status page.

jen-sre: grabbing logs for RCA; suspect interplay of long-tail prefix churn + connection pool exhaustion. Will post a short postmortem tomorrow with timelines.

luis-support: closing out immediate customer outreach; will update tickets with mitigation summary.

aj-night: acknowledged takeover. Monitoring channel and will escalate if >5% error rate sustained for >10m. Good handoff, thanks everyone. :heavy_check_mark:
